name: Solitary pulmonary nodule, low probability (<4 mm)

set.management: No follow-up CT is needed. The same spot in a high-risk patient (smoker, over 40, family history, workplace fiber exposure) may get a repeat CT at 12 months.

name: Non-small cell lung cancer, stage I-IIIA (resectable)

set.presentation: A 68-year-old woman with 35 pack-years had a CT-guided biopsy of a 2.8-cm peripheral left upper lobe mass: malignant cells with ample cytoplasm and no nuclear molding. She walks 2 miles a day; no headache, bone pain or weight loss. Calcium, ALP, AST, ALT and bilirubin normal.

name: Non-small cell lung cancer, stage IV

set.workup: Bronchoscopic biopsy of the lung mass: malignant cells with ample cytoplasm and no nuclear molding; tissue sent for tumor marker testing. Staging CT: a 3-cm right adrenal mass; skeletal scintigraphy: uptake in two ribs; alkaline phosphatase raised.

name: Small cell lung cancer, limited disease

set.management: Curative intent, usually without surgery: polychemotherapy (cisplatin and etoposide) plus chest radiation, then prophylactic cranial irradiation if the tumor responds to the first chemotherapy.
